infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Wantok Ride uses your location to set your pick-up point and show the vehicles nearest you.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Wantok Ride shares your location during a trip, and for 60 minutes after an SOS, so we can find you.

extra.comment: The Play Store ships two builds from this one codebase. WANTOK_VARIANT selects which shell boots: 'customer' or 'driver'. Unset shows the role picker, which is the development default.
